title: 删除操作后的最大子段和
summary: 正整数数组按指定顺序删除元素，每次返回剩余连续子段的最大和。
insight: 逆序处理删除，把操作变成添加。激活一个位置时用并查集与已激活左右邻居合并并维护分量和；添加前的当前最大值就是对应删除后的答案。
pitfalls: 答案记录在逆序添加之前

solutions.title: 逆序添加并查集
solutions.idea: 动态维护激活连续段的总和与最大值。
steps: 激活 removeQueries[i]，分量和为 nums[index]
与左右 active 邻居 union，更新 maximum

code.java: class Solution { int[] parent;long[] sum;private int find(int x){return parent[x]==x?x:(parent[x]=find(parent[x]));}private long union(int a,int b){a=find(a);b=find(b);if(a==b)return sum[a];parent[b]=a;sum[a]+=sum[b];return sum[a];}public long[] maximumSegmentSum(int[] nums,int[] removeQueries){int n=nums.length;parent=new int[n];sum=new long[n];boolean[] active=new boolean[n];long[] answer=new long[n];long maximum=0;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){answer[i]=maximum;int index=removeQueries[i];parent[index]=index;sum[index]=nums[index];active[index]=true;if(index>0&&active[index-1])union(index,index-1);if(index+1<n&&active[index+1])union(index,index+1);maximum=Math.max(maximum,sum[find(index)]);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumSegmentSum(nums:IntArray,removeQueries:IntArray):LongArray{val n=nums.size;val parent=IntArray(n);val sum=LongArray(n);val active=BooleanArray(n);fun find(value:Int):Int{var x=value;while(parent[x]!=x){parent[x]=parent[parent[x]];x=parent[x]};return x};fun union(x:Int,y:Int){val a=find(x);val b=find(y);if(a!=b){parent[b]=a;sum[a]+=sum[b]}};val answer=LongArray(n);var maximum=0L;for(i in n-1 downTo 0){answer[i]=maximum;val index=removeQueries[i];parent[index]=index;sum[index]=nums[index].toLong();active[index]=true;if(index>0&&active[index-1])union(index,index-1);if(index+1<n&&active[index+1])union(index,index+1);maximum=maxOf(maximum,sum[find(index)])};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> parent;vector<long long> sum;int find(int x){return parent[x]==x?x:parent[x]=find(parent[x]);}void unite(int a,int b){a=find(a);b=find(b);if(a!=b){parent[b]=a;sum[a]+=sum[b];}}public:vector<long long> maximumSegmentSum(vector<int>& nums,vector<int>& removeQueries){int n=nums.size();parent.resize(n);sum.resize(n);vector<bool> active(n);vector<long long> answer(n);long long maximum=0;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){answer[i]=maximum;int index=removeQueries[i];parent[index]=index;sum[index]=nums[index];active[index]=true;if(index&&active[index-1])unite(index,index-1);if(index+1<n&&active[index+1])unite(index,index+1);maximum=max(maximum,sum[find(index)]);}return answer;} };
